parent_objective: audit no-reset support-first reset-validation adapter result before reset validation
blocked_by: M1866 adapter pass requires audit before reset-only validation is admitted
supersedes: direct reset validation without adapter result audit

public_gates: M1867 must audit M1866 result_class counts diagnostics and guardrails before reset validation
M1867 must decide reset-validation design versus adapter/schema repair
M1867 must not run reset rollout measured rollout training replay PPO ranking paper-level or level3 claims

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits clean M1866 converted reset payload before reset-only validation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: adapter result audit only; no reset, rollout, measured rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1866 result_class is not pass
stop if any target count or guardrail is violated
stop if payload does not contain executable_v2_panel_specs
stop if reset validation would be admitted without explicit design
fallback_plan: route to reset-validation execution design if audit is clean
route to adapter repair if schema diagnostics fail
route to materialization repair if support-first artifacts are insufficient

admission_evidence: M1866 summary exists and reports adapter pass
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1867 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for reset-validation execution design or adapter repair

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: not applicable; adapter result audit is task-quality infrastructure.
history_necessity_tests: Audit must keep converted profile controls available for later history-necessity evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1866 adapter result only; no reset or rollout.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If M1866 conversion is not clean, route to adapter/schema repair rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no reset, rollout, measured rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The clean M1866 no-reset adapter output is sufficient to admit a reset-validation execution design over the converted support-first payload.
success_criteria: audit checks result_class counts diagnostics and guardrails
audit chooses reset-validation execution design or repair route
no reset rollout measured rollout training replay PPO ranking or paper-level claim is made
failure_criteria: audit ignores failed counts or guardrails
audit routes directly to measured execution or ranking
audit changes actor inputs reward dynamics or termination behavior
decision_rule: M1867 passes if it audits M1866 and routes to reset-validation execution design or repair without running reset, rollout, ranking, or paper-level claims.
